scope: Content-only claim-ledger completeness and alignment of selected bilingual cues with demonstrationNotes and RSI reference notes. Style axes were ignored.
alignment_unit: selected-cues.json plus RSI demonstrationNotes and chapter metadata in content.ts plus RSI section of reference.md

checks.finding: Improved system returns as the next improver; C and later improvement remain conditional.
External prewritten sorting programs; comparisons plus writes, six fixed tests, rejected B and retained C remain scoped.
A changes its own tool; frozen foundation-model weights are retained in supporting notes.
B is evaluated and can attempt later self-modification; branching archive and bounded coding evidence are preserved.
Tool change, tests and A/B sequence are explicit teaching illustrations without measured results.
Model supplies solution steps; questions, answers and initial demonstrations come from outside.
Filtering uses final-answer matches; answer-hinted retry and the lack of a reasoning guarantee remain in the supporting notes.
Trained B makes the next training-solution batch. Each original-paper training round restarts from the original checkpoint; no live training or measured gain is claimed.
Gemini-proposed training computation improvement is checked for correctness and speed; precise tiling scope is retained.
Reported average 23 percent kernel/routine speedup and approximately 1 percent total training-time saving remain distinct; comparison baseline is retained in supporting notes.
No demonstrated trained-successor handoff or improved research ability is claimed.
Human-defined objectives, evaluation and compute budgets remain explicit; later improvement needs comparable independent evidence.

observations: Some technical qualifiers are intentionally absent from the oral cue but retained in demonstrationNotes and reference.md; pass applies to the combined artifact, not to each oral cue in isolation.
DGM self-modification, STaR iterative training-data feedback and the incomplete AlphaEvolve successor loop are now distinguished; the text does not assign equal RSI evidence to all three.

Final wording-only changes were inspected: R9 says That is what comes back into the next round; R0 takeaway says The assistant improves itself, then takes over the next round. Neither changes the content verdict.
limitations: No external research was re-verified in this audit.
No runtime, animation, rendered layout or generated-note synchronization acceptance is asserted.
verdict_hash_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes of verdict_payload serialized by ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress, without BOM or trailing newline.

scoped_input_sha256.boundary: demonstrationNotes.rsi: from line beginning two spaces rsi: [ through the first subsequent two-space ], line
RSI chapter: from line beginning two spaces { id:rsi (single-quoted value) up to but excluding the closing chapter
RSI reference section: from ## RSI through the next level-2 heading or EOF, excluding the next heading

scope_hash_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 extracted section text with CRLF normalized to LF; no BOM. Shared-file full hashes are snapshot information; scoped hashes bind the audited RSI text independently of unrelated chapters.
